name: Foundation
subtitle: Guard Position & Mindset

shots.desc: Introduction: the contract between coach and student. Why guard comes first.
Guard position from front, side, behind, 45-degree. Hold for 10s each.
Fist formation close-up. Thumb placement. Knuckle alignment.
Foot placement: weight distribution 50/50, metatarsus, heel height.
Eye line: gaze above lead knuckles. Chin to shoulder.
Error: chin up. Error: guard too low. Error: excessive tension. Show each then correct.
3x3min shadow movement maintaining guard. Show the gate test.
Closing: obstacle-removal philosophy. Guard is resting AND returning state.

talkingPoints.point: Guard is a POSITION, not a posture or halt
Cuban system teaches one universal guard
The obstacle-removal philosophy: mastery was always there

loganNote: Module 1: Digital Logan demonstrations could supplement live filming for  concept visualization. Character sheets (Kael, Logan, Vet's Mitts) as visual reference for course aesthetic.

citations.claim: Guard position is a position, not a posture or halt
Gaze always above knuckles of lead hand
Rear foot metatarsus only, heel 3-5cm off ground
Guard is resting AND returning state
